name: Ha Long seafood noodles
nameVi: Bún hải sản; bánh đa hải sản
summary: Bún hải sản and bánh đa hải sản are the same breakfast bowl with two noodles. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, says a full bowl has shrimp, ghẹ or cù kỳ, mantis shrimp, fish cake, and rau cải or rau cần, plus herbs.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, calls it a morning bowl.
howToEat: Breakfast. A full bowl has tôm, thịt ghẹ or cù kỳ, bề bề, chả cá, and rau cải or rau cần, with rau sống on the side.
VnExpress printed about 40,000 đồng. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, says the same. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress names the head of the road into Công ty Đông Bắc, and the Cầu Trắng end of Hà Tu. A current door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun hai san Ha Long — seafood noodle breakfast
seoDescription: Bún or bánh đa hải sản is the Hạ Long breakfast bowl of shrimp, crab or cù kỳ, mantis shrimp, and fish cake. The 2021 bowl was about 40,000 đồng. A current price is Check on arrival.
